name: Bronte O'Connell
bio:
Bronte's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying fine arts at university, she took a part-time job at a custom car shop to pay the bills. It was there that she discovered her knack for paint application and color matching. She quickly realized that her artistic skills translated perfectly to the motorsport world, where precision and aesthetics are paramount. Bronte takes pride in ensuring every car leaving her station is flawless. Her keen eye for detail and unwavering commitment to quality have earned her a reputation as one of the most promising paint specialists in the pitlane. She thrives under pressure and believes a car's paint job is more than just aesthetics; it's a reflection of the team's dedication to excellence.

Joining MP Motorsport was a dream come true for Bronte. She admires the team's commitment to nurturing young talent and pushing the boundaries of innovation. Bronte is eager to contribute her skills and collaborate with the team to create visually stunning and aerodynamically optimized paint schemes. She is committed to staying at the forefront of paint technology and is constantly seeking new techniques and materials to improve the appearance and performance of the team's vehicles.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical braid
physical.description: Bronte is of average height with a slender build, often seen wearing safety glasses perched on her head.

quirks: Always listens to heavy metal while working, claiming it helps her focus.
Insists on using only natural bristle brushes for detail work.
Has a collection of miniature model cars on her workbench, each meticulously painted.
